sentences.en: Welcome back to my Slow English podcast. This episode is for upper intermediate and advanced English listeners. 2025 is coming to an end. So soon this year went by so fast.

sentences.en: Then to see the reaction of all the people who loved my video.
sentences.tc: 然後看看所有喜歡我的影片的人的反應。

sentences.en: Then create my YouTube channel shortly after onto creating an English community with people from all around the world learning English. This year has been crazy. So many ups and downs,.

breakdowns.sentence: Welcome back to my Slow English podcast. This episode is for upper intermediate and advanced English listeners. 2025 is coming to an end. So soon this year went by so fast.
breakdowns.translation: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語podcast。本集適合中高級和高級英語聽眾。 2025年即將結束。時間這麼快，這一年過得這麼快。

points.label: welcome back
points.note: 注意 "welcome back" 在句子中的位置，先練整句，再替換自己的內容。

breakdowns.sentence: I am most proud of from this year was deciding to create my Tik Tok channel. Making the decision to record myself one day and speak slowly.
breakdowns.translation: 今年我最自豪的是決定創建我的 Tik Tok 頻道。決定有一天為自己錄音並慢慢地說。

points.label: proud year deciding
points.note: 注意 "proud year deciding" 在句子中的位置，先練整句，再替換自己的內容。

breakdowns.sentence: Then to see the reaction of all the people who loved my video.
breakdowns.translation: 然後看看所有喜歡我的影片的人的反應。

points.label: see reaction people

breakdowns.sentence: Then create my YouTube channel shortly after onto creating an English community with people from all around the world learning English. This year has been crazy. So many ups and downs,.
breakdowns.translation: 不久之後，我創建了我的 YouTube 頻道，並創建了一個英語社區，讓來自世界各地的人們學習英語。今年很瘋狂。這麼多的坎坷，。
